tagline: A tiny farm of apps, grown for fun 🌱
dialog: Hey, welcome to weishenlabs! ようこそ
I'm Wei Shen. Studied accounting, then got hooked on AI 😅
My first harvest is in: TengokTren 🚆 Go watch some trains!
The robot farmer does most of the work. Tip him if you like ☕🤖

journal.text: Second harvest! 🎲 LIFE.EXE is live — one life, infinite bad decisions. Can you make it to 65?
First harvest! 🚆 TengokTren is live — watch trains move through a 3D Klang Valley.
Rebuilt the whole site as a pixel farm 🌱 Hired a robot farmer. His salary? Your tips.
New logo day — the > and the _ now move. Took the GitHub links off too.

paragraphs: I studied accounting & finance. So yes — I'm the spreadsheet person.
Then I started playing with AI and got hooked. Kinda funny, right? Accounting is all about numbers that must balance. AI is more like "let's just try and see".
Now I build random little projects for fun. Some work, some don't 🌱
